name: aiogram-transactional-middleware-context-scopes
instr:
Aiogram cannot keep middleware data, resources, and irreversible effects in one reliable lifecycle during event dispatch. Add opt-in transactional context scopes without changing existing middleware, dispatcher entry points, returns, identity resolution, FSM strategies, callback timing, or webhook responses.

Nested scopes read parent data but isolate additions, replacements, and deletions until terminal completion commits or discards them. Abandonment records `MiddlewareOutcome.ABORTED`. Repeated completion raises `MiddlewareTransactionError`, a `RuntimeError`, without changing committed state. `MiddlewareOutcome` is a str and distinguishes success, handled or unhandled errors, skips, explicit cancellation, task cancellation, and abandonment.

Publish correlated user context atomically. Hold FSM values only during isolation, always restore locale state, and commit recovery context only when an error observer handles the original exception. Control exceptions bypass error propagation; unhandled failures preserve the original exception object. Record callback answers as irreversible effects and send them at most once. Stop chat-action tasks before scope completion.

Isolate every candidate handler and recursive router branch. Only the first handling branch commits. Skipped candidates expose no staged values; later handlers see one complete user-context group.
